shots.action: The subject's skin drains to grey and cracks, dark veins spread up the neck and the eyes cloud over white as they turn into a zombie and slowly tilt their head.
shots.sound: Dry cracking, a low guttural growl and eerie strings.

end.paint: Turn the person into a horror-movie zombie: grey cracked skin, dark veins, clouded white eyes, frayed clothes, eerie cinematic light, nothing gory. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.
